description: Erection of detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the building
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1995/3B  Received:  16 November 2020
Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  01 October 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used only for purposes incidental to the use of 27 Netheravon Road, W4 2NA as a single family hose or other purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 27 Netheravon Road, W4 2NA, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows, doors and other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear outbuilding hereby approved.
